title: PuVVNL v. Pulkit Yadav — notice on CGRF average Smart Meter billing order
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Misra and Vikas Budhwar, JJ.
disposition: Notice issued; Forum order to be abided without prejudice pending the writ.
headnote: On PuVVNL's writ alleging that the CGRF directed average Smart Meter billing from 2015 without deciding whether the 30.11.2020 bill complied with the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the Allahabad High Court held only that the matter required consideration, issued notice to the consumer, and permitted the licensee to abide by the Forum order without prejudice. The Code was not construed.
facts: Purvanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited filed a writ against a Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum order obtained by Pulkit Yadav directing electricity bills on average Smart Meter reading from 2015. The DISCOM alleged the Forum never decided whether the 30 November 2020 bill was lawful under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and that average-billing directions could not issue without that finding. On 25 August 2022 the matter was adjourned as advocates abstained. On 13 September 2022 a Division Bench issued notice to the consumer.

holding_units.topic: CGRF average Smart Meter billing — notice without Code construction
holding_units.holding: The Division Bench treated as requiring consideration the licensee's challenge that the CGRF directed average Smart Meter billing from 2015 without deciding whether the 30 November 2020 bill was lawful under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; issued notice to the consumer; and permitted the licensee to abide by the Forum order in the meantime without prejudice to realizing the bill depending on the writ. No provision of the Code was construed.

principle_tags.application: Notice and a without-prejudice interim to abide the CGRF order; the alleged Supply Code defect in the 30.11.2020 bill and the average-billing direction were left for later consideration.

not_decided.point: Whether the bill dated 30.11.2020 was lawful or in violation of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: The issue the licensee said the CGRF failed to address; the writ was listed for consideration.

not_decided.point: Whether the CGRF could direct billing on average Smart Meter reading from 2015 without deciding the correctness of that bill
